name: WCIWF Card #1
no_appearances_reason: Roughly 34 named wrestlers plus a 3-person broadcast team and a named on-screen president appear across this card; no character records were minted per the depth-is-an-annotation rule -- the full roster, matches and results live in the page text.
notes: The fed's own full inaugural show, its only complete card to survive in the held record. Opens with a 20-man field drawn for the WCIWF World Title battle royal, then runs an eight-man WCIWF TV Championship tournament (The Great Oni defeats The Jet in the final, 11:33, to become the first TV Champion) alongside an eight-man WCIWF US Championship tournament whose final between Mr. Wonderful and Harley Hatfield ends in a double count-out, leaving the US title unclaimed. A seven-team tag-team elimination gauntlet -- stipulated to crown both the WCIWF World Tag and WCIWF US Tag champions in one match -- is won by The British Battlers (Jumping Jack Jones and The Brown Bomber), with PAIN (Xtra Tuff and Everlasting Payne) the last team eliminated before them and named US Tag champions. The card closes on the previously-drawn 20-man World Title battle royal, won by Jumping Joey Smith as the fed's first World Champion. The federation's own president, an in-fiction authority figure, is referenced twice during the broadcast; the broadcast team's own sign-off names him again by a shared forename at the foot of the post -- treated as the operator's own self-portrayal, not an out-of-character disclosure (see the served page's own provenance paragraph and a workshop file).
